collection.title: Aston Martin Virage 1988 to 1995 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Aston Martin Virage 1988 to 1995 model which requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 22" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
